title: Vercel Deployment Readiness & Environment Separation Audit Report

applicationArchitecture.type: Full-Stack (Client SPA + Optional Express Workspace Server)
applicationArchitecture.frontendMode: React 19 SPA communicating directly with Firebase Firestore & Auth
applicationArchitecture.backendMode: Express server (server.ts) for optional Google Workspace Drive/Sheets sync
applicationArchitecture.vercelCompatibility: Frontend SPA 100% Vercel compatible; Express server can be deployed to Cloud Run or Vercel Serverless Functions

firebaseConfiguration.environmentDrivenVerification: CONFIRMED — Configuration separated from core business logic

supportedEnvironments: ENVIRONMENT A: Vercel Preview / Test → Firebase Test Project
ENVIRONMENT B: Company Production → Firebase Production Project

firebaseAuthentication.authorizedDomainsRequirement: Must configure authorized domains in Firebase Console (e.g. *.vercel.app for Preview, app.company.com for Production)

firestore.accessModel: Direct Web SDK connection from client + Server-side Firestore Rules enforcement
firestore.securityRules: firestore.rules deployed to both Test and Production projects

vercelConfiguration.recommendation: Optional vercel.json with SPA rewrites to /index.html for client-side routing
